notes.title: Dev Update:
notes.notes:
Almost fried my brain, but the quest system is nearly done! Just a couple of bugs left to squash before we move to the best part—working on the demo.

Soon, we’ll start putting together the first playable chunk for you to try. 🎮 In the meantime, drop your ideas—what part of the game would you like to see in the demo first?

Oh, and don’t forget to check out our YouTube Shorts and TikTok for cool clips and updates! Subscribe so you don’t miss out. 🚀

notes.title: ✅ Dev Update: Steam Cloud Implemented ✨
notes.notes:
Just finished integrating Steam Cloud support for Endless Leveling in Mycelium Dungeons. When the game launches, your saves will sync across devices.

More updates coming soon. Feel free to wishlist if you want to follow the project's progress.

Also you can join to our discord to chat with devs btw - https://discord.gg/8xUvjrGayB
